verdict_text:
NO

The plan never asserts that exactly 48 tensors were merged, which is one of the explicitly "Required checks." It also never verifies that the three checkpoints share the *same tensor names* (spec step 1) — it only checks tensor counts for ft1/ft2 and asserts value-equality on the non-MLP regex, which would silently pass even if a non-MLP tensor were renamed or an MLP tensor were missing/extra, since equality assertions don't enforce key-set identity. This violates "verify that the three checkpoints have the same tensor names ... Abort with an error if not" and the required "exactly 48 tensors were merged" check.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
